The page contains a single full-page advertisement for CIBA Limited, Basle (Switzerland), consisting of an aerial photograph of the company's factory complex with an inset text box describing its products (colours for the textile industry, synthetic indigo, auxiliary products, pharmaceutical specialities, fine chemicals, cosmetic and hygienic preparations, plastics, moulding powders, synthetic resins) and the large "CIBA" logotype across the image.
